unclassified_narrative.quote: The Business File headers has four major functions:
unclassified_narrative.raw_quote: The Business File headers has four major functions:

unclassified_narrative.quote: Identifies the file exchanged: each file must have a unique File Identifier.
unclassified_narrative.raw_quote: Identifies the file exchanged: each file must have a unique File Identifier.

unclassified_narrative.quote: Describes the type of message(s) exchanged: by default, the type of messages contained in a file will be ISO 20022 message definitions.
unclassified_narrative.raw_quote:
Describes the type of message(s) exchanged: by default, the type of messages contained in a file will
be ISO 20022 message definitions.

unclassified_narrative.quote: The Business File Header (head.002) is to be used exclusively in existing implementations, such as the Eurosystem, and will be replaced for general use by the upcoming next version defined as the Business File Envelope (nvlp.002).
unclassified_narrative.raw_quote:
Usage: The Business File Header (head.002) is to be used exclusively in existing implementations,
such as the Eurosystem, and will be replaced for general use by the upcoming next version defined as
the Business File Envelope (nvlp.002).

unclassified_narrative.quote: The Business File Header (head.002) will therefore not be maintained in the future and any new implementation must use the Business File Envelope (nvlp.002).
unclassified_narrative.raw_quote:
The Business File Header (head.002) will therefore not be
maintained in the future and any new implementation must use the Business File Envelope (nvlp.002).
